Tax Payment Information
Real estate tax statements are mailed by December 26th. Mobile home tax statements are also mailed in December.
A 5% discount is given on the consolidated tax if paid by February 15th of each year.
Postmark is accepted as proof of timely payment.
Failure to receive a tax bill does not relieve the obligation to pay real estate taxes.
